🚧 ZOMBIE BORDERLINE [BETA]
Welcome to the Quarantine Camp. Here, your judgment is law. Filter refugees by day—decide who is safe and who is infected—then gear up before night falls. Use your hard-earned Cash to upgrade your arsenal, choose your Class, and ensure the Camp survives the relentless Boss attacks.

How long can you hold the line?

📁 GAME FEATURES
🛡️ Class System: Choose specialized roles with unique weaponry.

💉 Quarantine Duty: Screen refugees and manage camp security.

⚔️ Survival & Upgrades: Earn Cash to buy and power up your gear.

💀 Boss Encounters: Face massive threats that test your team’s limits.

🎁 MILESTONE: 1,000 LIKES
Help us reach 1,000 Likes to unlock the next Update:

🆕 New Special Class ⚔️ New Weapon Tier 👹 New Zombie Boss

🛠️ DEVELOPMENT INFO
The game is currently in Beta. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please report them to our Community Discord via the link below!
